question: Is one default board plus an explicit multi-select choice enough, before any integration work is admitted?

artifacts.summary: POC seed. The tool currently decides which boards appear — the story map always, and the function map whenever the file happens to carry a command field, which is a hidden rule. Ask instead, allow more than one, and draw the user journey alone when nothing is said. All three projections already exist and none is deleted; this changes the default and who chooses, not what any board draws. No integration with plan-flow, dev-flow or spacedock in this task.
